task: State-based CRDT library (ae.crdt) with merge-law and gossip convergence tests against oracles
reasoning_summary: Immutable state-based CRDTs whose merge is a join: pointwise max for counters, total-order stamp for LWW, tag union plus tombstone union for OR-set. Tests pair literal scenarios (concurrent add/remove, ties) with merge-law checks and seeded gossip simulations compared to independently tracked oracles.
